payload.title: File:Large-Billed Crow Egg.jpg
payload.description_html: Nest and clutch of a Large-billed crow in the Philippines. They usually nest very high up in a tree, but this particular nest was only 8 meters from the ground. It was found at Basak, Lebak, Sultan Kudarat, Philippines, on the farm of the Wikipedia User.
